market_definition: The styrene-butadiene latex adhesives market comprises water-based adhesives made from styrene-butadiene rubber lattices, including carboxylated grades. It measures sales of finished adhesives for carpet backing, paper, flooring and construction bonding. BY LATEX TYPE: Carboxylated SBR, Non-Carboxylated SBR, Other Styrene-Butadiene Lattices. BY FORM: Standard Dispersion, High-Solids Dispersion. BY END-USE INDUSTRY: Carpet & Textile Backing, Flooring & Construction, Paper & Paperboard, Foam & Mattress Bonding, Other End-Use Industries. BY REGION: North America, Latin America, Europe, Asia Pacific (APAC), Middle East, Africa. EXCLUDED from the market: Polychloroprene latex and contact adhesives; natural rubber latex adhesives; SBR latex sold for paper coating or tyre use. COMPANY TYPE IN THIS LIST - DISTRIBUTOR: a distributor, stockist or specialty reseller that buys these products from their makers and sells them to industrial, construction or trade customers. EXCLUDED companies: product and raw-material makers and their own sales subsidiaries; companies selling only the excluded products; service-only firms.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR DEFINITION (physical goods market): a company whose PRIMARY business is buying in volume from manufacturers and reselling/distributing onward - wholesale, authorized, value-added or stocking distributor. EXCLUDED: channel partners, resellers, VARs, dealers, agents and brokers that do not stock or wholesale; manufacturers and OEMs (including a manufacturer's own sales subsidiary); system integrators; and pure service providers or consultancies. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER.
